_comment: The Priest's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json, the Hunter's
layout): a class tree and the three WotLK specializations, in the order of their talent tabs
(Discipline, Sacré, Ombre), which is the order the bots take them in. Nodes marked existing reuse the
WotLK talents' own spells or name an ability authored in localTools/priest/Spells.ps1; the others are
generated by localTools/talentTree/TalentRankSpells.ps1 and read by modules/mod-priest. The Priest keeps
mana; Shadow fights with Insanity (Démence, an aura of stacks). Each spec learns its core abilities and
a hidden passive (specSpells): Discipline Penance and Power Word: Radiance, Holy the Holy Words Serenity
and Sanctify, Shadow Mind Flay, Vampiric Touch and Shadowform. botBuild is the order a bot takes its
nodes in; presets are the recommended single-target (raid, tank healing) and AoE (dungeon, group
healing) builds (bots take the AoE one in dungeons). Ids 93400-93499 are the new talent ranks.
